versions.text: Criterion: Verify that residual oscillations characteristics are safe. Standard: The air vehicle meets the standards within MIL-STD-1797, 5.2.1.7 Residual oscillations. For rotorcraft, the air vehicle meets standards within ADS-33-PRF, 3.1.17 Residual oscillations. For unmanned air vehicles residual oscillations do not interfere with operation of the aircraft or accomplishment of mission tasks. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, test, demonstration, simulation, and inspection of process, requirements, design, test, and configuration documentation.

Standard: Air vehicle flying qualities due to experiencing any sustained residual oscillations in calm air are no worse than Level 2. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis and simulation to assess any sustained residual oscillations in normal acceleration about trim at the pilot station in calm air as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Residual Oscillations paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, and flight phases. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the air vehicle's residual oscillation tendencies and characteristics in calm air as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Residual Oscillations paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, and flight phases. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the air vehicle's residual oscillation tendencies and characteristics in calm air as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Residual Oscillations paragraph for selected combinations of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, and flight phases.
